sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Stable, Barrier

system.description:
You weave together metallic chakra with earth release techniques fusing them together until you conjure a wall of pure Steel.

This wall appears, originating in a space, within range, then growing in size. The Wall is 2 feet thick, and is composed of ten, 10-foot by 10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. Alternatively, you can creature a steel wall surrounding the permitter of a 20-Foot Radius sphere.

This barrier has 4d8 + 10 hit points and 20 AC. For its duration, if you spend an Ingot as part of your Alomancy clan feature, the wall regains 2d8 hit points.

While your wall has hit points, you can spend your bonus action causing metallic spike to be erected from the surface of one side of the wall, forcing all creatures within 10 feet of the chosen side to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 piercing or slashing damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

Alomancy Infusion. If you have the Metallic Thorns or Super Sharp Alomancy Technique; you can spend 1 ingot as part of this jutsu’s casting to cause the wall summoned to be serrated in form and shape. Creatures in the area of the Jutsu when its summoned, attempting to wall run on the wall, or make a melee attack against the wall must make a Dexterity saving throw gaining 2 ranks of Bleed on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the hit points of the wall by 1d8 + 2.
